hubHeading: Six core departments. One coordinated campus.
hubIntro: Each department below links to a detail page with its illustrative approach to care. A few more specialties are available by request — see "More Specialties" further down, or reach out directly.

departments.name: Cardiology & Heart Care
departments.summary: Preventive screening through to post-procedure follow-up, coordinated with our emergency and internal medicine teams.
departments.overview: Our cardiology team focuses on catching patterns early — blood pressure, cholesterol and rhythm irregularities — well before they become emergencies, alongside structured care for patients already managing a heart condition.
commonlyManaged: Routine cardiac screening and risk assessment
departments.approach: Every new cardiology patient gets a written care plan in plain language, reviewed with you before you leave — not mailed to you later.

departments.name: Orthopedics & Joint Care
departments.summary: Joint, spine and sports-injury care, from first consult through physiotherapy-supported recovery.
departments.overview: From a nagging knee to planning a joint replacement, our orthopedics team pairs surgical consultation with an in-house physiotherapy track, so recovery planning starts on day one, not after discharge.
departments.approach: We default to the least invasive option that's medically appropriate, and explain the trade-offs of each path before recommending surgery.

departments.name: Neurology & Spine Care
departments.summary: Headache, nerve and spine-related care, with imaging and physiotherapy coordinated on-campus.
departments.overview: Persistent headaches, nerve pain, or a spine concern that hasn't resolved with rest — our neurology team works through a structured assessment before recommending imaging, so you're not sent for scans you don't need.
departments.approach: Every imaging recommendation comes with a plain-language explanation of what we're ruling in or out, before you consent to the scan.

departments.name: Pediatrics & Child Health
departments.summary: Routine checkups, vaccinations and child-focused urgent care in a space designed to feel less intimidating.
departments.overview: A separate pediatric wing, a play corner instead of a waiting room, and consultations that talk to the child first and the parent second — our pediatrics team is built around making a hospital visit less stressful for kids.
departments.approach: We explain every step to the child in age-appropriate language before doing it — not just to the parent.

departments.name: Maternity & Women's Health
departments.summary: Prenatal care through delivery and postnatal follow-up, alongside general women's health consultations.
departments.overview: From a first prenatal visit to postnatal follow-up, our maternity team keeps one consultant assigned to your case where possible, so you're not re-explaining your history at every visit.
departments.approach: We talk through delivery preferences early and revisit the plan together as the pregnancy progresses, not just in the final weeks.

departments.name: Emergency & Trauma Care
departments.summary: Round-the-clock emergency assessment and stabilization, coordinated directly with the relevant specialty team.
departments.overview: Our emergency department is staffed for rapid assessment and stabilization, with a direct line to whichever specialty team a case needs next — cardiology, orthopedics, neurology — so handoffs happen fast.
departments.approach: If you are in a real medical emergency, call your local emergency number immediately — do not use this website, or any website, to decide whether to seek emergency care.

disclaimer: Department pages describe illustrative areas of care for a fictional hospital. Nothing here is medical advice, a diagnosis, or a treatment recommendation — always consult a qualified clinician, and call your local emergency number for any real emergency.
